'''Jundo Martik''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as one of the [[Mayor/Legends|Mayors]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], within the [[Outpost Salara|Salara Outpost]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He tasked a Republic spacer to drive off the [[Twin Suns (pirates)|Twin Suns]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] who had taken over the local [[Twin Suns mining compound|mine]], which most of the town worked within.<ref name="TOR:RtW" />
